content: आदेशः .²1 An order, command; भ्रातुरादेशमादाय <ls>Rām.</ls>; आदेशं देशकालज्ञः प्रतिजग्राह <ls>R. 1. 92</ls>; राजद्विष्टादेशकृतः <ls>Y. 2. 304</ls> doing acts forbidden by the king. .²2 Advice, instruction, precept, rule; आदित्यो ब्रह्मेत्यादेशः <ls>Ch. Up. 3. 19. 1</ls>; <ls>Ken. 4. 4</ls>; <ls>Bṛ. Up. 2. 3. 6</ls>. .²3 Account, information, relation, pointing out, indication. .²4 A prediction, prophecy; विप्रश्निकादेशवचनानि <ls>K. 64</ls>; see सिद्धादेश also. .²5 (<ab>Gram.</ab>) A substitute; धातोः स्थान इवादेशं सुग्रीवं संन्यवेशयत् <ls>R. 12. 58</ls>. .²6 (In astrology) Event, result, consequence of the conjunction of stars. .²7 Determination to perform (a ritual <ab>&c.</ab> संकल्प), vow; उद्धृतं मे स्वयं तोयं व्रतादेशं करिष्यति <ls>Rām. 2. 22. 28</ls>.
